# Command catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-llm-docs.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Options belong to the command they are declared on, so they must appear
before the next subcommand: `psq -i <dir> lighthouse -a <dir> playback`.

## psq

Record a web page through a proxy, edit the recording, and replay it to measure the difference

```
Usage: psq [options] [command]

Record a web page through a proxy, edit the recording, and replay it to measure
the difference

Options:
  -v, --version          Output the version number
  -i, --inventory <dir>  Inventory directory (default: "./inventory")
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  lighthouse [options]   Run Lighthouse (performance category) via a proxy
  loadshow [options]     Run loadshow via a proxy
  proxy [options]        Run the playback (or recording) proxy standalone
  capture [options]      Capture a screenshot via playback proxy and optionally
                         compare with a baseline
  llm [options]          Print the embedded reference for AI agents
  help [command]         display help for command
```

### psq lighthouse

Run Lighthouse (performance category) via a proxy

```
Usage: psq lighthouse [options] [command]

Run Lighthouse (performance category) via a proxy

Options:
  -a, --artifacts <dir>      Artifacts directory (default: "./artifacts")
  -l, --laud                 Show browser and open the report after completion
                             (default: false)
  -t, --timeout <ms>         Timeout milliseconds (default: "30000")
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  recording [options] <url>  Record contents by lighthouse
  playback                   Playback contents for lighthouse
  help [command]             display help for command
```

#### psq lighthouse recording

Record contents by lighthouse

```
Usage: psq lighthouse recording [options] <url>

Record contents by lighthouse

Arguments:
  url                            Url to measure performance

Options:
  -d, --device <mobile|desktop>  Device type (default: "mobile")
  -x, --exclude <pattern>        Regex patterns to exclude URLs from recording
                                 (repeatable) (default: [])
  -h, --help                     display help for command
```

#### psq lighthouse playback

Playback contents for lighthouse

```
Usage: psq lighthouse playback [options]

Playback contents for lighthouse

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### psq proxy

Run the playback (or recording) proxy standalone

```
Usage: psq proxy [options]

Run the playback (or recording) proxy standalone

Options:
  -p, --port <number>      Proxy port (default: "8080")
  -r, --record <url>       Recording URL to start the proxy as recording mode
                           (default: "")
  -x, --exclude <pattern>  Regex patterns to exclude URLs from recording
                           (repeatable) (default: [])
  -h, --help               display help for command
```

### psq capture

Capture a screenshot via playback proxy and optionally compare with a baseline

```
Usage: psq capture [options]

Capture a screenshot via playback proxy and optionally compare with a baseline

Options:
  -a, --artifacts <dir>     Artifacts directory (default: "./artifacts")
  -t, --timeout <ms>        Timeout milliseconds (default: "30000")
  --compare <file>          Baseline PNG file to compare against
  --baseline-label <label>  Label for the baseline image (default: "前回")
  --current-label <label>   Label for the current image (default: "今回")
  -h, --help                display help for command
```

### psq llm

Print the embedded reference for AI agents

```
Usage: psq llm [options]

Print the embedded reference for AI agents

Options:
  -f, --format <markdown|json>  Output format (default: "markdown")
  -h, --help                    display help for command
```
